scope: Isolated Stage measurements with prepared fonts. Public route/module-transfer startup and final site-wide performance remain unverified.
findings: The corrected benchmark uses elapsed deadlines, records every control event and asserts all expected state transitions. Slow frames cannot omit the later actions or pointer leave.

All twelve corrected stories completed. Full rendering remains below the frame target, mobile full Wave first paint exceeds 300ms, and the corrected native mobile engraving sample records a 306ms startup outlier. Retain both measurements.
Private DOM/canvas-backend, integer camera, deferred-paint and field-math-cache probes showed no reliable performance improvement; production drawing and models are unchanged.

measurements.scope: Actual isolated native and complete full Stage CPU-throttled stories at desktop DPR1 and mobile DPR2. Fonts are prepared before mounting. First contentful paint and observed readiness are recorded; CDP traces bind paint/layout work and frame gaps. These measurements do not declare final timing gates passed or include public route/module transfer.
